jordan.label: Jordan (country)
jordan.desc: country in Western Asia, a kingdom east of Israel with capital Amman; an Arab state in the Middle East that imports wheat and grain

jordan.label: Michael Jordan
jordan.desc: American basketball player who played for the Chicago Bulls in the NBA, scored many points and won six championships

jordan.label: Jordan River
jordan.desc: river in West Asia which flows through the Sea of Galilee to the Dead Sea; its waters, plain and valley appear in the Bible

shell.label: Shell plc
shell.desc: British multinational oil and gas company, formerly Royal Dutch Shell, active in petroleum refining, crude oil, fuel and gasoline

shell.label: seashell
shell.desc: hard protective outer layer created by a marine animal such as a mollusc, snail, clam or oyster, often found on beaches by the sea
